candidate.title: scAba-seq
candidate.scope: The Illumina poster row titled scAba-seq / Detect 5hmC marks in single cells with AbaSI nuclease: a single-cell, strand-specific 5hmC library architecture from hydroxymethylated DNA through glucosylation, AbaSI digestion, cell-barcoded adaptor ligation, pooling and the broad T7 amplification block ending in DNA. The Single cell and 5hmc residues icons introduce the analyte. Primer labels the adaptor reagent. Nearby scTrio-seq, scBS-seq, scRC-Seq and the chemical legend are outside this target; no alternative target workflow is shown. The matching collection page has the same heading and sequence. Primary support for the target method is abstract-level; the separate supplied full-text paper describes SCL-exo as background, not another target.

operations.label: T4-βGT
operations.description: Modify 5hmC residues in the individual-cell DNA by glucosylation, producing the glucose-marked DNA depicted to the right.
operations.mechanism: T4 phage β-glucosyltransferase adds glucose to 5hmC; the enzyme is a catalyst, not a product or retained library component.
operations.information_effect: Changes the chemical recognition substrate while retaining the genomic DNA and its cell of origin.

operations.label: AbaSI
operations.description: Digest the glucosylated DNA into fragments with the staggered ends drawn at the next boundary.

Cleavage is not proof of exhaustive or perfectly specific recovery of all 5hmC sites: the catalogue flags sequence bias and ambiguous cleaved molecules. Exact position-assignment rules and cut offsets are outside the supplied depiction.

unknowns.question: What intervening operation(s) connect T7-transcribed RNA to the endpoint labeled DNA? The matching catalogue explicitly identifies T7 RNA polymerase in vitro transcription, while the diagram shows only a broad T7 amplification block and DNA endpoint. The supplied target-paper abstract does not resolve this interface. Target-paper methods or a primary workflow figure would be needed to specify the conversion; no reverse-transcription or other unshown operation is inserted here.

What exact cleavage-to-5hmC offset and strand-assignment rule underlie the genomic readout in this implementation? The figure and target abstract support strand-specific 5hmC mapping but provide neither rule nor read structure. Target-paper methods would be needed for finer positional claims; this does not block the depicted library architecture.

checks.rationale: Accepted at the declared Illumina schematic scope after independent image and source inspection. Every in-scope transformation and interface is represented: individual-cell hydroxymethylated DNA → glucosylated DNA → AbaSI fragments → cell-barcoded adaptor-ligated fragments → mixed DNA pool → broad T7 amplification block ending at the diagram’s DNA label. Primer is a reagent, and the left analyte illustration does not specify a lysis protocol. The only joint operations are supported adaptor joining and actual DNA pooling; no separate branches are collapsed. All eight states, five operations, twelve material flows, method applicability, three paper matches and two unknowns were checked. The candidate distinguishes the DNA-labeled endpoint from catalogue-reported RNA transcription and makes no claim that T7 polymerase directly synthesizes DNA. No consequential unsupported assertion, omitted depicted branch, or paper-supported correction requiring incorporation was found.
